summary.text: Terry Wanzek is a Republican state senator from District 29 in Jamestown who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat John Kelly.
A farmer, rancher and businessman, he chairs the Appropriations Committee's Government Operations Division.

paragraphs.text: Terry Wanzek earned a B.A. from Jamestown College in 1979 and later completed an executive program at Texas A&M University.
His professional experience includes work as a farmer, rancher and business owner, and his legislative biography lists service as past president of the North Dakota Grain Growers.

He has served on the board of governors of the University of Jamestown and the boards of Nodak Insurance Company and Jamestown Regional Medical Center, and he is married with three children and seven grandchildren.
Wanzek's legislative biography lists House service in 1993-1994 and Senate service from 1995 to 2002 and since 2007.
He chairs the Appropriations Committee's Government Operations Division and the interim Budget Section's Government Operations Division.
